Expected value must be forward-looking from today. Sunk $400,000 is gone in both options and is excluded.

Option continue:
Expected gross return = P_success * Return_success + P_fail * Return_fail
= 0.30 * 800,000.00 + (1 - 0.30) * 50,000.00
= 0.30 * 800,000.00 + 0.70 * 50,000.00
= 240,000.00 + 35,000.00
= 275,000.00

Expected net from today if continue = Expected gross - Future cost to finish
= 275,000.00 - 500,000.00
= -225,000.00

Option stop:
Expected net from today if stop = Sale value - Future cost
= 0.00 - 0.00
= 0.00

Recomputed check: Continue = 240,000 + 35,000 - 500,000 = -225,000. Stop = 0.

Comparison: 0.00 > -225,000.00, so stop maximizes expected value from today. Better value = 0.00 USD.
